svg.title: Ethereum Ghosts: how a ghost is made
svg.text: Ethereum Ghosts: how a ghost is made
From a trigger to a public page. Gemma writes the words; plain code finds, checks and decides every fact.
Only Vercel and Discord are closed.
a call to the local model
open-source agent harness · persona SOUL.md · terminal tool only
answers only from the files it names;
never decides a kind, a date or a wound
the agent's model, via Ollama: alias
reads the chat, picks a skill row
browsing tools (contract of the day, search…)
quoted when asked; never replaces a haunt
checks arguments, one haunt at a time,
builds the report line in code (no model)
hermes send --to discord: one line to the
home channel; without Discord the line
blocks sudo, rm -rf, git push, vercel,
launchctl, hermes cron… by command text:
a command policy, not a sandbox;
the agent runs as my macOS user
The ghosts pipeline: Python CLI “ghosts haunt”, one ordered chain per ghost
resumable: a step whose output file exists is skipped · face and og never stop the chain · an alive pick is skipped and the picker tries again (3 tries)
Inside story: the only step that calls the model
every Gemma call sees only its own facts; every sentence it writes is checked by code
gemma4:12b-it-qat in Ollama on my Mac,
words only: code holds the facts
Internet Archive captures of the dapp's
compiles every fix before it is shown
one line built in code by haunt.sh:
Ghost of the day: name (kind, era).
Online, not offline: the data sources are web services; the model, the checks and the files are local. Hermes talks to Gemma through Ollama's
OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint; the pipeline calls Ollama's native /api/chat. Diagram checked against the code on 2026-10-29.
